text:
Elena: quick design check — compact deployments table: focus halo for icon-only actions (copy/pin/more) gets clipped at the bottom when density token is set low (6px). can we audit?
Mike: saw that on staging too. which browser and row height?
Elena: Chrome, rows 36px. tab to the copy icon and the bottom half of the halo is hidden.
Tara: looks like a pattern: icon buttons use margin:-4px for pixel alignment and tr has overflow:hidden. combination will clip external halo.
Josh: negative margins were a shortcut. long-term i'd rather avoid them. options: remove overflow:hidden, switch to padding-based alignment, or change focus to an inner/inset style. inset is less discoverable though.
Aria: accessibility first: focus must be visible and not cause layout shift. prefer outer halo but we need to keep dropdowns working. maybe box-shadow on the button contained inside the row is best.
Mike: pragmatic fix: special-case icon buttons to render focus via box-shadow rather than relying on outline escaping the container. sample: `button.icon:focus { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--focus-200); }`
Tara: box-shadow keeps things inside overflow:hidden and avoids changing row overflow rules. will prototype.
Josh: note visual weight of halo in compact density — we should reduce halo size to 2px there so icons don't feel visually heavy.
Elena: also found generic aria-labels like `aria-label="copy"`. need contextual labels: `aria-label="Copy deployment id"` or `Copy <name> id`. screen readers currently say "button copy" which is unhelpful.
Aria: prefer runtime-generated `aria-label` that includes the deployment name. also suggest adding `aria-live="polite" role="status"` on an ephemeral inline toast for copy confirmation.
Mike: inline toast makes sense — anchor a small transient toast near the icon, 1.5s duration, with check icon. ensure it is `position:absolute` inside the row so it doesn't push layout.
Tara: implementation notes: keep pointer-events:none for toast, focusable=false, and make sure it doesn't steal keyboard focus.
Josh: Figma update: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/compact-tables?node-id=204%3A12 — added frames showing 2px halo in compact and 3px in default/spacious.
Elena: QA checklist: keyboard-only traversal, VoiceOver on mac, NVDA/JAWS checks, visual diff across compact/default/spacious, regression for dropdown clipping.
Tara: timeline: I'll open a draft PR today with box-shadow focus + contextual aria-labels + inline toast. won't change row overflow yet.
DesignBot: ticket created DS-901 for compact table icon focus + inline toast.
Mike: please include before/after screenshots and notes about token impact in PR.
Aria: once PR is up i'll run screenreader tests.
Elena: thanks team — follow up on token MR if we decide to increase row padding later.
Tara: draft PR -> #2358, pinging when ready for review. :sparkles:
Josh: great work, thanks! :thumbsup:
DesignBot: Reminder: design sync tomorrow 10am.
